fills.researcher_notes: ONE COMPANY QUESTION answered once and applied across the whole brief (P0904, P0911, P0923, P0933, P0943 -- GAIL's five regional/basin gas networks): GAIL (India) Ltd is not just the owner (already staged as Owner1 [ref] by the register-crosswalk leg off the same PNGRB physical-progress register, batches/india-gas/staging/register-crosswalk/staged_resolutions.json) but the OPERATING entity. Evidence is PNGRB's tariff-order machinery, which is issued specifically 'to be charged by the entities laying, building, operating or expanding a natural gas pipeline' (Section 22, PNGRB Act 2006 -- identical language recurs in every order below, so it is the statutory basis for every tariff order PNGRB issues, not boilerplate specific to one filing). A tariff order is addressed to the party that actually transports gas as a common carrier and charges shippers for it -- i.e. the operator -- not to a passive equity holder, so this is a genuinely distinct fact from ownership even though the same company (GAIL, no SPV) happens to hold both roles here. Direct evidence for Agartala: the Tariff-MIS register's own row for it (Sr. 6, PL Unique ID 17.08.NGPL): 'Agartala Regional Network | GAIL | 13.12.2010 | 55 | 2 | 65 | 28-07-2022/31-05-2023 | 2.06 | ... | Tripura' -- GAIL is named as Entity, and the row shows TWO separate PNGRB tariff-order dates issued to GAIL for this specific network (28-07-2022 and 31-05-2023), which only happens if GAIL is the party PNGRB is regulating as transporter/operator, not merely recorded as an equity owner. PNGRB Tariff-MIS register (https://pngrb.gov.in/data-bank/20260113-NGPL-Tariff-MIS.pdf, 'Details of Applicable Tariff for Operational NGPL's', dated 13.01.2026) lists Entity=GAIL for all five networks in this brief. tier=medium, independent=true: PNGRB regulatory documents are a genuinely separate origin from the GAIL company reports GEM typically cites (matching the register-crosswalk leg's own independence call on the parallel Owner fill), though I'm holding at medium rather than high because both cited documents ultimately trace to the same regulator rather than two unrelated organisations -- flagged rather than overclaimed. url_verifier FAILs on both PDFs (200 but missing expected substring) -- documented large-PDF false negative per the protocol; downloaded and confirmed locally with pdftotext -layout. Never cited gem.wiki or globalenergymonitor.org. Operator is written 'GAIL (India) Ltd' by the source; spelled the ownership team's way as 'GAIL Ltd'.
